home.title: Batches
home.statement: 4x35 turns free-text payment addresses into ISO 20022 structured addresses, with a reason for every field and a person's approval for every change.
home.stepOneBody: Upload a list or a payment file and pick a bank pack. The health report shows what fails and why.
home.stepTwoBody: Each proposed field shows where it came from. Anything without a source is left empty, never guessed.
home.stepThreeBody: Check the payment file against the pack, then download it with an audit report.
